a2-indefinidosnegacion-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Nobody in the Kitchen
a2-indefinidosnegacion-01.scenario: You are staying at the home of Carlos's grandmother in Madrid. Carlos heard a noise in the kitchen and asks whether you saw anyone there. You saw no one.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you did not see anyone in the kitchen.
cues: Say you did not see anyone
a2-indefinidosnegacion-01.target: No he visto a nadie en la cocina.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-01.english: I haven't seen anyone in the kitchen.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-01.canDo: I can ask whether someone is there and say that nobody is, using alguien and nadie.

a2-indefinidosnegacion-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Nothing to Eat
a2-indefinidosnegacion-02.scenario: You are at the Madrid office where Carlos works for a few days. Carlos asks if you want something to eat before you leave. You want nothing, but you have some water.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you don't want anything and that you have some water.
cues: Say you do not want anything
Say you have a little water
a2-indefinidosnegacion-02.target: No quiero nada, gracias. Tengo algo de agua.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-02.english: I don't want anything, thank you. I have some water.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-02.canDo: I can ask for something and say that I want nothing, using algo and nada.

a2-indefinidosnegacion-03.title: Communicative Challenge: No Plans for the Weekend
a2-indefinidosnegacion-03.scenario: Carlos's grandmother asks in Madrid whether you have any plan for the weekend. You have none, and you ask if she has one.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-03.prompt: Tell her you have no plan and ask whether she has one.
cues: Ask if she has a plan
a2-indefinidosnegacion-03.target: No tengo ningún plan para el fin de semana. ¿Tienes algún plan tú?
a2-indefinidosnegacion-03.english: I have no plan for the weekend. Do you have any plan?
a2-indefinidosnegacion-03.canDo: I can say that I have some or no plan, doubt or problem, using algún, alguna, ningún and ninguna.

a2-indefinidosnegacion-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Neither Do I
a2-indefinidosnegacion-04.scenario: At dinner at the grandmother's home in Madrid, Carlos says that he doesn't like the cold. You don't like it either.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-04.prompt: Agree with Carlos and say you never go out without a jacket.
cues: Agree that you don't like it either
a2-indefinidosnegacion-04.target: A mí tampoco me gusta el frío. Nunca salgo sin chaqueta.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-04.english: I don't like the cold either. I never go out without a jacket.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-04.canDo: I can agree with a negative sentence using tampoco and say what I never do using nunca.

a2-indefinidosnegacion-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Nobody Told Me
a2-indefinidosnegacion-05.scenario: In the Madrid office, a colleague of Carlos asks you whether you know anything about tomorrow's meeting. Nobody told you anything.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-05.prompt: Tell the colleague that you don't know anything and that nobody told you about the meeting.
cues: Say you do not know anything
Say nobody told you about the meeting
a2-indefinidosnegacion-05.target: No sé nada. Nadie me dijo nada sobre la reunión.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-05.english: I don't know anything. Nobody told me anything about the meeting.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-05.canDo: I can combine nadie, nada, ningún, tampoco and nunca in short conversations.

a2-indefinidosnegacion-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Quiet Day in Madrid
a2-indefinidosnegacion-consolidation.scenario: In the evening at the grandmother's home in Madrid, Carlos asks what you did today. You did nothing and saw nobody.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that today you did nothing and saw nobody.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-consolidation.target: Hoy no he hecho nada y no he visto a nadie.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-consolidation.english: Today I haven't done anything and I haven't seen anyone.
a2-indefinidosnegacion-consolidation.canDo: I can use indefinite and negative words to talk about people, things and time in everyday conversation.
